title: Click Z - Graduate Content & Audience Strategist
description: <p>Do you follow every shift in digital marketing, media and commerce, and always have a view on which stories matter the most?</p> <p>Do you want to create content across channels that educates the next generation of marketers?</p> <p>Does the idea of shaping the content for one of digital marketing's longest-running publications excite you?</p> <p><strong>If so, we'd love to hear from you!</strong></p> <hr> <h2>About us</h2> <p>Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working — across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop — down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on. Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, and Lululemon use Fospha up to 25 times a day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform — and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.</p> <p><strong>About ClickZ</strong></p> <p><a href="https://clickz.com/">ClickZ</a> is Fospha's media partner and one of the world's longest-running digital marketing publications, trusted by CMOs and senior marketers since 1997. Its focus is how measurement shapes marketing decisions, and it covers the wider marketing that measurement informs. Readers come to ClickZ to understand:</p> <ul> <li>How marketing leaders build teams, explain results to finance and earn influence in the room</li> <li>Retail and commerce marketing, including retail media and marketplaces</li> <li>How AI, search and ad platform changes affect planning and results</li> <li>Where to invest across brand, creative, performance, affiliate and influencer marketing</li> <li>How brands measure performance, from attribution and incrementality to mix modelling</li> </ul> <h2> </h2> <h2>The Role</h2> <p>This is a permanent role at the heart of ClickZ. You'll run the day-to-day content engine: spotting the stories that matter to marketing leaders, turning them into sharp content across email, social and the website, and growing the audience that reads it.</p> <p>The work is varied. In a single week you might cover a session at a major commerce event, publish a piece on a platform change, prepare a leadership Q&A, and review a stack of contributor pitches. title: Commercial Customer Success Manager
description: A little about us incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime. The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously. We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join. The role in one line Customers trust us when things go wrong. We're the software reliability platform built to investigate, respond to and prevent incidents. As a Commercial CSM, you're the partner to our mid-market engineering teams - getting them onboarded, embedded and expanding their usage, and maturing their incident management and reliability as they grow. What that looks like day to day Our Customer Success organisation is at the heart of incident.io . We're the team closest to our customers' hardest problems, and we're trusted to solve them. We believe in a customer-led product approach, working hand in hand with Product to uncover and address what each customer really needs. Our goal goes beyond satisfaction: we want to delight customers at every stage of their journey, and build long-term relationships grounded in trust, shared success and mutual growth. You'll look after 70–80 Commercial customers: growth-oriented tech companies, mostly under 1,000 people, between $30k and $150k ARR each. Industry leaders like Vanta, Monday.com and Loom sit in this segment. Some are steady, some are scaling fast, and much of the job is knowing which is which, and what each one needs from you. Most of your time goes to mid-market customers on our top-tier plan, where you're their dedicated CSM leading onboarding and adoption. You'll blend 1:1 time with scalable programmes to get teams to value quickly: best-practice sessions, end-user training, partnership and roadmap reviews. You'll also cover a subset of smaller customers in a low-touch capacity, leaning on usage data to spot risk and opportunity early. Day to day, this is a high ownership role. You'll help customers navigate the product, unpick problems when they hit them, and keep everyone pointed at the outcomes their team actually cares about. You are responsible for proactively identifying expansion and upsell opportunities, and partnering with Sales and Expansion Account Managers to grow revenue within your accounts. Internally, you're the voice of the Commercial customer with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing and Support. There's still a lot to build and a ton of opportunity for you to shape this segment. The Commercial motion works, but scaling and automating the customer journey is live work we're ramping up now - refining playbooks, automating the repeatable stuff, building the tooling and content that makes a portfolio this size easier to serve. We're AI-forward in how we approach it, so you'd be shaping this rather than inheriting it. Who you are You've carried a book of 40 to 100+ accounts and worked out how to be present across all of them without going quiet on half. You've sold to, or supported, technical people, whether that's engineering teams, on-call rotations or developer tools. You can hold your own in a technical conversation without needing to escalate every one of them. You've got commercial instincts. You spot the account that's about to double, you know what a growth signal looks like, and you know how to steer a renewal to a good outcome. You know what scaled CS looks like when it's done well. Playbooks, one-to-many programs, AI-assisted workflows. You don't need to have built them from scratch, but you've worked around them enough to have opinions on what you'd do differently. Half-built process doesn't rattle you. You'd rather fix the documentation than complain about it. You actually like being in a room with customers, and you'll get on a plane for the right one. Supporting you We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both. Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover — we want you and the people you love to be looked after. Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that. First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously. Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought. Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it. Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too. Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them. Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself. description: Senior Data Protection Engineer (Backup & Cyber Resilience) Location: Windsor, UK Introduction We’re hiring a S enior Data Protection Engineer to join a global hosting and managed services team . The team runs business-critical, highly regulated systems for organisations around the world, many of them in healthcare, where losing data or failing to recover it is not an option. This is a senior role with real influence. You’ll own the enterprise backup and recovery platform across all regions. You’ll set the standards for how data is protected, retained and restored, and you’ll show, with evidence, that recovery targets are met. You’ll also help shape where data protection services go next, at a time when cyber resilience matters more than ever. Responsibilities & Tasks Run the platform globally. Lead the engineering, administration and continuous improvement of an enterprise Rubrik environment. This covers configuration, upgrades, capacity planning, health monitoring, security hardening and lifecycle management. Set the rules. Design and enforce global protection policies, including SLA tiers, retention, archiving, replication, immutability, encryption and access controls. Turn requirements into protection. Convert business, regulatory, contractual and risk needs into clear protection tiers, RPO and RTO targets, and practical operating procedures. Keep coverage complete. Bring new workloads into the service and keep protection accurate across on-premises, cloud, virtualised, database and application environments. Keep operations healthy. Monitor backup, replication, archiving and restore activity. Fix failed jobs, capacity pressure, performance issues and policy exceptions before they become risks. Prove that recovery works. Plan and run restore tests, disaster recovery exercises and readiness reviews, and keep the evidence that recovery targets and controls are met. Strengthen cyber resilience. Work with security and incident response teams on ransomware readiness, anomaly investigations, clean-recovery planning and privileged-access controls. Build strong governance. Write the runbooks, standards and procedures that define good practice, and help regions and technology teams adopt them consistently. Lead when it counts. Take technical ownership during incidents and service disruptions, and drive root cause analysis and lasting corrective actions. Automate. Use APIs, scripting and orchestration tools to automate routine operations, compliance checks, reporting and workflows. Report clearly. Give regular insight into protection coverage, recoverability, compliance, capacity, platform risk and operational performance. Work across teams. Partner closely with infrastructure, cloud, database, application, security, risk and business continuity colleagues, and take part in a shared on-call rota for critical production services. Requirements & Qualifications Essential: A solid track record of engineering and running enterprise-scale backup, recovery and data protection services Extensive hands-on production experience with Rubrik A current Rubrik Certified System Administrator (RCSA) certification Experience designing and rolling out data protection policies, standards and operating models across multiple regions A strong grasp of retention, immutability, encryption, access control, RPO and RTO, and recovery validation Hands-on involvement in disaster recovery, cyber recovery or ransomware-resilience initiatives Strong troubleshooting skills, and familiarity with incident, change and problem management processes Experience supporting production services in a 24x7 or on-call environment Benefits & Culture Global reach and visible impact: Your work will directly protect critical services, including healthcare systems that clinicians and care providers rely on every day. Real ownership: You’ll have a strong voice in policy design, retention strategy, cyber resilience, automation and the long-term direction of the service. Collaborative environment: You’ll join experienced engineers and architects who value shared ownership, operational excellence and openly sharing knowledge. Growth and development: You’ll keep developing your skills on an enterprise-grade platform, with support for certifications and continuous learning. Competitive rewards: The package includes market-aligned pay and comprehensive benefits that reflect a senior technical role. If you want to make data protection dependable at a global scale, we’d love to hear from you. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description: <p>We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to contribute to cutting-edge Research & Development. As innovators in speech technology, our mission is to Understand Every Voice - a vision that has propelled us to be world leaders of Voice AI. Fuelled by innovation, inclusivity, and a passion for making a global impact through world-leading Speech AI, we're looking for an experienced Senior Machine Learning Engineer to accelerate our efforts towards exceptional speech solutions.</p> <p>Our Modelling Team trains diverse models, including large self-supervised ones, supporting Speechmatics towards being the most accurate speech recognition system globally. It also ensures their deployment into production, working with the latest developments in ML, but also with the best engineering practices for software engineering and model serving.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work on complex R&D projects, with a diverse group of engineers, to achieve ambitious goals.</li> <li>Stay current with the latest developments in Machine learning.</li> <li>Execute high-impact projects to ensure team success.</li> <li>Work collaboratively across departments and mentor team members (where appropriate).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who we are looking for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrated experience in collaboratively pursuing ambitious R&D agendas.</li> <li>Precise attention to detail, but is also aware of how the big picture relates to company goals, and where the field of Machine Learning is headed towards.</li> <li>Understanding of the modern Machine Learning stack, for example:<br>- Knowledge of contemporary transformer architectures (e.g., GQA, KV-caching) and best practices.<br>- Experience in distributed training techniques.<br>- Familiarity with optimisation strategies for model inference (e.g., dynamic batching, flash attention, speculative decoding).</li> <li>With preferred backgrounds covering <span style="text-decoration: underline;">some</span> of the following:<br>- Publications in top-tier conferences.<br>- Contributions to popular open-source repositories.<br>- Technical writing skills as evidenced by relevant publications or blogs.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><span class="ui-provider a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ab ac ae af ag ah ai aj ak">We encourage you to apply even if you do not feel you match all of the requirements exactly. The list of requirements is intended to show the kinds of experience and qualities we’re looking for, but it is not exhaustive. If you are interested in the role, the team, and our mission, we would love to consider your application. We are always open to conversations and look forward to hearing from you.</span></em></p> <p><strong>Who we are:</strong></p> <p class="p1">Speechmatics is the leading expert in Speech Intelligence, and uses AI and Machine Learning to unlock business value in human speech worldwide. We work with an amazing mix of global companies, and our technology can integrate into our customers stack irrespective of their industry or use case – making it the go-to solution to harness useful information from speech.</p> <p class="p1">Joining us means working with some of the smartest minds around the world, focused on cutting-edge projects and deploying the latest techniques to disrupt the market. We believe in putting people first; we’ll do all we can to help you develop your skills and give you the tools you need to thrive. Our Focus Fridays give you an undisturbed day of focus, offset with Together Tuesdays when we have our team meetings, so you've always got the right balance.</p> <p class="p1">We have structured a hybrid approach that includes 2-3 designated office days each week. This arrangement ensures that while we embrace the advantages of remote work, we also maintain the vital connection and synergy that only in-person interactions can foster.</p> <p class="p1">This is only the beginning; we’re looking for amazing people like you to continue our journey…</p> <p class="p1"><strong>What we can offer you:<br></strong></p> <p class="p1">No matter what stage of your career you’re at - from paid internships and first-job opportunities through to management and senior positions - we’ll support you with the training and development needed to reach your career aspirations with us. There really is no shortage of opportunities here for you to get involved and collaborate with those around you to deliver your best work.</p> <p class="p1">We offer incredibly flexible working, regular company lunches, and birthday celebrations. But that’s not all. We’ve spoken to our teams to find out what they want. From Private Medical, and Dental for you and your family, through to global working opportunities, a generous holiday allowance and pension/401K matching, we want to make sure our employees and their families are looked after. Every employee will receive a working from home allowance for tech or home office equipment (on top of your choice of laptop and accessories of course). Our approach to parental leave is designed to support employees globally. While this varies by geo, we have support in place for parents (including adoption assistance and reproductive health services) to ensure they have the time and financial resources needed to care for their growing families.</p> <p><strong>At Speechmatics, our mission is simple: Understand Every Voice out there.</strong> </p> <p>That's not just about our tech – it's the heart and soul of who we are. We welcome different experiences, viewpoints, and identities. For us, it’s not just the right thing to do; it’s our catalyst for sparking innovation and creativity. Our teams thrive in an environment that celebrates and supports everyone – no matter their gender, identity or expression, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion, belief, marital status, national origin, veteran status, pregnancy, or maternity status.</p> <p>But we don’t just open the door to diversity – we actively welcome it. Why? Because we believe every unique voice adds something special to our team, leading us to smarter solutions and a better workplace.</p> <p><strong>So, come as you are and join our Speechling community.</strong> We’re building a place where every voice not only gets heard but is also respected and valued.</p> <p>For more information on us<sub>, </sub>please visit <a href="https://www.speechmatics.com/">our website</a> and follow Speechmatics on our social channels via <a href="https://twitter.com/Speechmatics/">Twitter</a>, <a href="https://www.facebook.com/speechmatics/">Facebook</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/speechmatics/">LinkedIn</a>, and <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCaZUN77-Wq0XQg5ICHLxKVw/">YouTube.</a></p> <h5><strong><em>We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. </em></strong></h5> <h5><span style="color: #ffffff;"><strong>#LI-Hybrid</strong></span></h5></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Fospha - Click Z Graduate Content and Audience Strategist
description: <p>Do you follow every shift in digital marketing, media and commerce, and always have a view on which stories matter the most?</p> <p>Do you want to create content across channels that educates the next generation of marketers?</p> <p>Does the idea of shaping the content for one of digital marketing's longest-running publications excite you?</p> <p><strong>If so, we'd love to hear from you!</strong></p> <hr> <h2>About us</h2> <p>Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working — across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop — down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on. Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, and Lululemon use Fospha up to 25 times a day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform — and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.</p> <p><strong>About ClickZ</strong></p> <p><a href="https://clickz.com/">ClickZ</a> is Fospha's media partner and one of the world's longest-running digital marketing publications, trusted by CMOs and senior marketers since 1997. Its focus is how measurement shapes marketing decisions, and it covers the wider marketing that measurement informs. Readers come to ClickZ to understand:</p> <ul> <li>How marketing leaders build teams, explain results to finance and earn influence in the room</li> <li>Retail and commerce marketing, including retail media and marketplaces</li> <li>How AI, search and ad platform changes affect planning and results</li> <li>Where to invest across brand, creative, performance, affiliate and influencer marketing</li> <li>How brands measure performance, from attribution and incrementality to mix modelling</li> </ul> <h2> </h2> <h2>The Role</h2> <p>This is a permanent role at the heart of ClickZ. You'll run the day-to-day content engine: spotting the stories that matter to marketing leaders, turning them into sharp content across email, social and the website, and growing the audience that reads it.</p> <p>The work is varied. In a single week you might cover a session at a major commerce event, publish a piece on a platform change, prepare a leadership Q&A, and review a stack of contributor pitches. You'll also build ClickZ's network of event partners, contributors, PR contacts and industry leaders, and meet many of them in person at industry events.</p> <p>You'll work closely with ClickZ's lead, who sets the brand's strategy, and you'll have real ownership of your workstreams from the start. This is an <strong>office-based role</strong> in London.</p> <p>This role suits someone with a journalist's instinct for a story, a marketer's eye for an audience, and the energy to keep both going every week.</p> <h2> </h2> <h2>What you'll work on</h2> <p>Your time will be spread across three areas, with content creation at the core. All three serve one goal: growing the ClickZ brand and getting its content to more of the right people.</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>Focus area</th> <th>What it covers</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td>Content creation</td> <td>The core of the role: editorial content on market trends, event coverage, brand leadership interviews and Q&As, flagship newsletters, and social content</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Audience growth and content analysis</td> <td>Growing ClickZ's readership and subscribers, testing new formats, and using performance data to decide what to create next</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Network and community</td> <td>Building relationships with event partners, marketing and commerce leaders, PR teams and contributors, online and in person at industry events</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <h2> </h2> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Keep the content engine fed.</strong> Track the news and trends that matter to marketing and commerce leaders, and turn them into timely, well-argued content.</li> <li><strong>Raise the bar on every channel.</strong> Bring a creative eye to email, social and web content, and build a distinct content plan for each channel.</li> <li><strong>Shape the flagship newsletters.</strong> Draft and refine ClickZ's flagship newsletters, and develop more tailored formats for different parts of the audience.</li> <li><strong>Bring leadership conversations to life.</strong> Prepare and support podcast and Q&A conversations with leaders across marketing and commerce, and, with training and support, grow into hosting them.</li> <li><strong>Grow the audience.</strong> Work out which formats and topics readers respond to, and turn readers into subscribers. Design campaigns that bring back readers who've gone quiet.</li> <li><strong>Let data inform the calls.</strong> Track what content delivers, use the numbers to decide what to do next, and share what's working.</li> <li><strong>Be the first filter.</strong> Review PR pitches and contributor submissions, and pick out the strong and relevant ones.</li> <li><strong>Build the network.</strong> Reach out to contributors, speakers and event partners, grow an always-on contributor community, and build lasting relationships with PR teams and industry leaders.</li> <li><strong>Get out into the industry.</strong> Attend events, support event partnerships, and find new events worth ClickZ's time.</li> <li><strong>Work agentically.</strong> Use AI tools to speed up research, drafting and multimedia content, while owning the quality of what goes out.</li> </ul> <h2> </h2> <h2>What are we looking for?</h2> <p>We hire for potential and taste. You should apply if you meet these six must-haves:</p> <ul> <li>Have around one year of experience creating content in the digital marketing, media or commerce world, whether in journalism, editorial, content or social roles (internships, placements and personal projects count), and a genuine passion for digital marketing and commerce, and for the leaders shaping them</li> <li>Have <strong>strong editorial judgement</strong>: you can tell good content from weak, and relevant from noise, and you know a big story when you see one (experience of writing, editing or curating, including student or personal publications)</li> <li>Bring a <strong>creative eye to content</strong> across email, social and web, with a feel for multimedia formats</li> <li>Are <strong>audience-minded</strong>: you think about who's reading, how to reach more of the right people and how to build a community around a brand. You're also comfortable with data: you use performance numbers to make content decisions and back up your conclusions (experience using analytics such as GA4)</li> <li>Are <strong>agentically minded</strong>: you love experimenting with new tools for multimedia content creation and adaptation, and know when to push them and when to take over</li> <li>Are <strong>a natural conversationalist</strong>: you get a guest talking, hold your own with senior leaders, and leave an event with new connections</li> </ul> <p><strong>Also important:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have <strong>high agency</strong>: you take ownership of your work, stretch beyond the brief and challenge the status quo when something could be better</li> <li>Enjoy a fast-paced, innovative startup environment, where you'll ship quickly, iterate often and juggle several projects at once</li> <li>Are happy to travel for industry events, within the UK and occasionally overseas</li> </ul> <h2> </h2> <h2>Our Values and Principles</h2> <p>You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Seek inclusion & diversity:</strong> We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be heard</li> <li><strong>Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together:</strong> We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact</li> <li><strong>Grow:</strong> We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure</li> <li><strong>Customer at the heart:</strong> We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems</li> <li><strong>Candour with caring:</strong> We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude</li> </ul> <h2> </h2> <h2>What we can offer you</h2> <ul> <li>Salary: £34k + discretionary 10% bonus</li> commerce</li> <li>A place at major industry events, with a front-row view of commerce, media and digital marketing</li> <li>Be part of a leading global venture builder, <a title: Senior Business Development Manager - AI Native
description: <h2><strong>ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD:</strong></h2> <p>NexGen Cloud is the company behind Hyperstack, a full-stack AI cloud serving tens of thousands of customers from AI researchers to enterprises running the world's most compute-intensive workloads. We deliver on-demand and private GPU infrastructure to teams who treat performance as a requirement, not a feature.</p> <p>We're a tight-knit, fast-moving team working at the cutting edge of AI cloud infrastructure. We practice what we preach, equipping our people with AI at every level so we can solve harder problems, ship faster, and keep raising the bar for what enterprise GPU infrastructure looks like.</p> <h2><strong>THE ROLE: Senior Business Development Manager – Vertical Markets</strong></h2> <p>Hyperstack already runs production GPU capacity at scale for AI start-ups, AI service providers and enterprise AI teams. This role exists to extend that position into compute-intensive, regulated and specialist industries — financial services, healthcare and life sciences, robotics and autonomous systems, computer vision and industrial AI — where compute budgets are already committed and infrastructure partners are being chosen now.</p> <p>You'll own a named vertical end to end: the demand thesis, the target account map, the outbound motion, and every deal through to signature. This is a full-cycle role with real ownership, not a top-of-funnel handoff — you'll become the recognised commercial authority for your vertical inside NexGen, and a credible presence in that industry externally.</p> <p><em>Role positioning: this is a role for a senior seller who already holds trust in a compute-intensive industry and wants full ownership of turning that trust into a book of business — the strategy, the pipeline and the close.</em></p> <h2><strong>WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:</strong></h2> <p>Rather than a long checklist, here's what success in this role looks like:</p> <ul> <li>Own a named vertical end to end — build the demand thesis, size the addressable market, and turn it into a prioritised target account map</li> <li>Self-source the majority of your own pipeline and reach the people who decide compute budget: CIO, CTO, Chief Data or AI Officer, and the procurement and risk functions that gate them</li> <li>Lead technical discovery to a real specification, then own the full cycle to signature — commercial proposal, security review, procurement, legal and MSA negotiation</li> <li>Structure multi-year committed reservations and on-demand entry points, and keep a forecast the business can plan capacity against</li> <li>Build Hyperstack's presence in your vertical — industry events, analyst and partner relationships, reference customers and case studies</li> <li>Feed vertical requirements into Product, Capacity and Marketing with enough specificity to change decisions, then follow through until they land</li> <li>Act as the internal reference point for your vertical — brief the wider Sales team and raise the technical floor around you</li> </ul> <h2><strong>ABOUT YOU:</strong></h2> <p>We're more interested in how you think and work than in a perfect CV. You'll likely bring a combination of the following:</p> <p><strong>Essential</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years in business development, enterprise sales or solution sales, including at least 3 years carrying a new business number in complex enterprise environments</li> <li>A demonstrable record of opening net-new enterprise logos from a standing start — self-sourced, not inherited and not renewal-led</li> <li>Deep credibility in at least one compute-intensive vertical — financial services, healthcare and life sciences, robotics and autonomous systems, computer vision and industrial AI, media and entertainment, or engineering and simulation — including an active network at buying level</li> <li>Substantive infrastructure fluency (cloud, IaaS, HPC, data centre, GPU or AI compute), or a proven history of learning a technical domain to the point of holding your own with engineers</li> <li>Evidence of closing complex deals through procurement, security review and legal, with contract values and cycle lengths you can talk to in detail</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience at a neo-cloud, GPU-as-a-Service platform, hyperscaler or HPC infrastructure vendor</li> <li>Prior ownership of a vertical or industry go-to-market as a named remit</li> <li>Familiarity with regulated buying environments — data residency and sovereignty, isolation requirements, and the security and compliance reviews that come with them</li> <li>Experience selling committed capacity or reservation-style contracts rather than pure consumption</li> <li>Formal sales methodology — MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or equivalent</li> </ul> <h2><strong>WHAT WE OFFER:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and accelerators above target, plus equity participation</li> <li>Private Medical Insurance </li> <li>Employee wellbeing benefits</li> <li>25 days of holiday, plus public holidays</li> <li>Hybrid working, with Tuesday to Thursday in the London office</li> <li>Real ownership of a named vertical, with the trust to build and run it as your own</li> <li>A clear route to principal-level individual contribution or vertical leadership as your vertical scales</li> <li>A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership</li> <li>The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud's team, culture, and future alongside ambitious, mission-driven colleagues</li> </ul> <h2><strong>MORE INFORMATION</strong></h2> <p>Head over to our <a href="https://www.nexgencloud.com/careers?utm_medium=organic&utm_source=google">NexGen Cloud</a> careers page to view current openings and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/nexgen-cloud">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://x.com/CloudNexgen">X</a> to learn more about our journey, newest releases and hear exciting news in the neocloud space.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Data Analyst
description: <p><strong>ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD</strong></p> <p>NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We're the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.</p> <p>We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.</p> <p><strong>THE ROLE: Data Analyst</strong></p> <p>NexGen Cloud is moving to a data-driven way of running the business. Right now, revenue, occupancy, billing and pipeline data live across data warehouses, business systems and APIs, and the numbers don't always agree. We're building out our Strategic Finance team so that leadership, sales and operations can rely on one set of figures and act on them daily.</p> <p>This role suits someone who enjoys the technical craft of data and wants to learn the commercial side of the AI compute market. We'll teach you that context. When a number looks wrong, you'll dig until you find why, and you'll come back with a fix as well as the problem.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING</strong></p> <p>Rather than a checklist, here's what success in this role actually looks like:</p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain the pipelines that bring data from across the business into Databricks and Power BI, and automate the manual steps along the way</li> <li>Own the daily revenue and occupancy reporting that leadership uses to track how the GPU fleet is performing</li> <li>Check that what we bill matches what customers actually used, covering power draw, utilisation, asset registers and credits</li> <li>Support commission calculations and give sales leadership a clear view of pipeline health, conversion and churn</li> <li>Model pricing options and deal economics so investment decisions are grounded in real numbers</li> <li>Validate every figure before it reaches leadership or anyone outside the company</li> <li>Help the wider team work confidently with BI tools and data</li> </ul> <p><strong>ABOUT YOU</strong></p> <p>We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You'll likely bring a combination of the following:</p> <p><strong>Essential</strong><em>:</em></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar role, including data extraction, integration or automation projects</li> <li>Strong SQL and Excel skills</li> <li>Solid Power BI experience, including reconciling figures when different sources disagree</li> <li>Hands-on use of a CRM (HubSpot or similar), and of AI tools to speed up analysis and build work</li> <li>A root-cause mindset: you find the underlying cause rather than reporting the symptom, and you bring a proposed solution with it</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with Databricks</li> <li>Exposure to billing, revenue assurance or commission processes, ideally in a cloud, SaaS or usage-based business</li> <li>Some experience with financial modelling or FP&A work</li> <li>Time spent in a high-growth company where data processes were still being built</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT WE OFFER</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme</li> <li>Employee wellbeing benefits</li> <li>25 days holiday, plus public holidays</li> <li>Private Medical Insurance</li> <li>Enhanced Pension Scheme</li> <li>Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)</li> <li>Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment</li> <li>Visible, meaningful impact as we scale</li> <li>Clear career progression in a high-growth company</li> <li>A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership</li> <li>The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud's team, culture, and future</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHY APPLY</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we'd like to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>MORE INFORMATION</strong></p> <p>Visit our <a href="https://www.nexgencloud.com/careers">careers page</a> to learn more about us or follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/nexgen-cloud">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://x.com/CloudNexgen">X</a> to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.</p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About AlphaSense: </strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit <span><a href="http://www.alpha-sense.com" target="_blank">www.alpha-sense.com</a></span>. Come join us.</span></p></div><h3>About the Team:</h3> <p>The Customer Success organisation is composed of three teams: Pre-sales, Customer Success, and Support. The Customer Success Manager will join a team of trusted partners alongside their Account Manager, working closely with newly onboarded and existing clients to demonstrate the full value of our platform, develop strong client engagement, drive successful renewals and contribute to growth across dedicated accounts. They are natural problem-solvers, storytellers and product experts who thrive on helping customers make better and faster decisions.</p> <p>Customer Success Managers combine deep product knowledge, industry experience and ability to build strong client relationships to ensure that each client interaction is both meaningful and impactful. Due to their extensive exposure to a variety of clients both on the buy-side and sell-side, they are the Voice of the Customer, working closely alongside our Product Management and Content teams to help determine future product developments, as well as playing a key role in product Betas and the customer feedback loop.</p> <h3><strong>About the Role: </strong></h3> <p>As a Forward-Deployed Banker, you will play a critical role in driving product adoption and delivering ongoing value to our clients, working closely with the wider account team to positively impact net retention. You’ll engage directly with clients and develop a comprehensive understanding of their workflows, challenges, and goals; bridging the gap between the powerful capabilities of our technology and the domain-specific needs of financial professionals across: Asset Management, Investment Banking, Private Equity/Venture Capital and Hedge Funds.</p> <h3>What You’ll Do:<span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Partner with GTM Teams to Drive Commercial Outcomes:</strong> Collaborate closely with your Account Manager and the wider account management team to ensure continuous alignment of account strategies and goals. <br></span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Leverage Data Driven Insights</strong>: Use internal data tools to monitor client engagement, identify opportunities to showcase value, and strengthen platform adoption. Proactively seek growth opportunities while also detecting early signs of churn risk to support retention and long-term account success.<br></span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Build and Curate Financial Services Use Cases:</strong> Conduct targeted discovery into clients' unique research workflows and painpoints in order to help them effectively leverage AlphaSense for their bespoke use cases. Continue to seek out and develop new and emerging use cases with clients as AlphaSense’s capabilities evolve.<br></span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Forge and Maintain Strong Client Relationships:</strong> Engage directly with investment professionals of all levels/seniority at financial institutions to understand their most pressing challenges and goals. Deliver white glove service that puts the clients needs first; going above and beyond to build trust and credibility as a Trusted Partner and Product Expert.<br></span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Contribute to Product Development:</strong> Translate client feedback and proactively share product & content improvements/enhancement requests internally.</span></li> </ul> <h3>Who You Are:</h3> <p>You have a proven track record of working with Financial Services investors/clients to solve complex problems and are passionate about the application of AI to the industry. You are client-centric and creative thinker with an ambition to continuously improve processes and a desire to contribute to a fast-growing, entrepreneurial team culture. You are a natural problem solver and prioritise white glove service to go above and beyond for clients. You enjoy autonomy and proactively drive initiatives that contribute to long term success. You enjoy cross-functional partnerships and are able to build strong internal stakeholder relationships.</p> <h3>What You Bring:</h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Financial Services Expertise:</strong> 2+ years of front-office investment banking experience, ideally with exposure to more than one product area (e.g., DCM, ECM, M&A, Leveraged Finance), providing a strong foundation in capital markets processes and client-facing deal work.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Curiosity About Generative AI in Financial Services</strong>: A demonstrated interest in the transformative potential of AI for the financial sector, flexible problem-solving skills and knowledge of the competitive landscape for GenAI in Financial Services.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Executive Presence & Strong Presentation Skills</strong>: A proven capacity to engage stakeholders at all levels, earn their trust, and explain technical solutions to business-oriented audiences. Comfort with conducting evaluations of varying lengths/forms e.g. on-site workshops, whiteboard sessions, multi-call demos etc.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>High-Impact, Ownership Mindset:</strong> An exceptional ability to thrive on autonomy, tackle client questions and challenges with enthusiasm, and drive workflow transformation at some of the world's biggest financial firms.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Consultative Approach:</strong> A highly articulate, consultative, and confident client-facing professional with the ability to distill and explain complex issues in simple terms.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Team Player: </strong>Superior ability to build and maintain strong internal relationships, combined with a positive and proactive personality.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Collaboration & Influence:</strong> Ability to work cross-functionally and effectively distill client feedback to GTM, Product, and Content teams, in order to continually help influence and improve our capabilities/product offerings.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>A Proactive Mindset</strong> with a passion for client success and continuous improvement</li> </ul> <h3>Requirements:</h3> <ul> <li>Minimum 2 years of front-office investment banking experience across at least one product area, with a solid grounding in capital markets and client-facing deal execution.</li> <li>High aptitude and willingness to learn.</li> <li>Outstanding oral, written, and presentation skills.</li> <li>Effective attention to detail, time management, and task prioritization, even when under pressure.</li> <li>Ability and interest to work autonomously and contribute to a dynamic and entrepreneurial team culture.</li> <li>Empathetic, curious minded, client-centric</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. title: Sales Engineer
description: At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution. We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints. With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge? About the role We are looking for a sales engineer to join our sales team and drive the frontline of industrial decarbonisation. This role bridges the technical and commercial worlds. You'll need interpersonal and technical skills to build relationships with process engineers in cement plants and understand their challenges. Analytical skills will be essential to delve deep into complex plant data and work out how Gigaton's AI products can solve their most critical issues. Building on that, you'll need strategic thinking and commercial awareness to turn your findings into concise, compelling proposals for decision-makers at our customers, from the C-suite down. Ultimately, you'll build clarity from uncertainty, making sure we agree a shared roadmap with our customers that puts our solutions on track for significant real-world benefits before a contract is signed. Over time, you’ll help us evolve our sales approach and shape the product by feeding insights and needs from the plant back to the product team, building the foundation for scaling across industries. Your main responsibilities Be the technical expert on sales calls and visits with cement plants. Build trust with process engineers and plant teams by understanding their specific plant issues and linking them to how we can help. Analyse plant data to identify and evaluate opportunities, then use this analysis to create compelling sales proposals. Lead technical discovery and identify early when a plant does not meet our ICP (ideal customer profile) criteria. Make sure relationships and plant understanding are handed over successfully to the deployment team. Act as a feedback loop into Gigaton’s product and machine learning teams, providing field insights that help shape our product roadmap. Develop and iterate the pre-sales technical process, making it more impactful and more automated each time. Travel to plants and conferences , around one week per month, to understand customer environments and explain the product. What a great fit looks like Exposure to physical sciences, controls, or heavy industry , such as cement, steel, energy, manufacturing, or similar. Strong analytical skills and an outcome-oriented mindset. You can dig into industrial data, identify root causes, generate potential solutions, and explain their value in dollars and tonnes of CO2. Excellent communication skills . You can build credibility and trust in complex industrial environments with both engineers and board-level stakeholders. Comfortable being the technical voice in the conversation , presenting to senior plant leaders and operators, handling objections, and being challenged on your findings by people who have run kilns for 30 years. Naturally curious and keen to learn about the industry, the technology, and each individual plant. You want to understand the root cause behind every question and objection so you can solve the right problem. Confident in ambiguity and able to field very specific technical questions without getting flustered. You know when you can give your understanding, when you need to go and find the answer, and how to maintain customer confidence in both situations. Willingness to travel regularly . You’ll excel if You build trust easily . You can connect with plant engineers, listen deeply, and align solutions to their priorities. You’d rather diagnose than pitch . Your first instinct in a plant is to ask a better question, not to open the deck. You thrive in dynamic environments . Fast-paced, ambiguous settings excite you, and you’re motivated by high-impact, mission-driven work. You have experience working in heavy industry , particularly cement, steel, energy, heavy manufacturing, or similar. Success in This Role Means Plants say yes because the technical case is clear. You build customer confidence that Gigaton can deliver high ROI, helping us hit our revenue goals without losing deals because customers don’t understand or believe in our product and capabilities. Deployments are set up to succeed . We haven’t overpromised to sign a contract, and our pre-contract analysis holds up once the system is live. Process engineers trust and rely on you as a partner in solving problems. Deals don’t stall waiting on a technical answer . Objections get handled quickly, and customers get the answers they need in good time. 💡 You are not expected to check every box, and we’d love to hear from you even if your experience isn’t an exact match. We’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Our people come from all walks of life, with different countries, cultures, and experiences, and we think that’s one of our biggest strengths. We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and celebrated. No matter your background, if you’re excited by what we do, we want to hear from you. The interview process Talent Partner Screen Call: Meet our talent partner and learn more about Gigaton and the role. Hiring Manager Screen: Meet our VP of Sales and discuss if this role is a good fit for you. Technical Onsite (completed on the same day): Technical interview Data analysis & presentation Operating Principles Interview: Understand how we work and whether Gigaton and you are a good fit for each other. Meet with the CEO: Every new potential hire meets Josh. We believe hiring is a two-way process. Just as we’ll reference-check candidates before making a final offer, we encourage you to reference-check us by chatting to team members you haven’t yet met. Ask anything. We’ll answer with Concrete Honesty. Once interviews are done, we’ll move quickly to a decision, and we’re always happy to give feedback at any stage. In return for your hard work, we’ll give you 📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside. 🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team. 🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge 🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one. Our Operating Principles ↗️ Go Gig or Go Home : High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires. 🏭 Concrete Honesty : Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture. 🦾 Autonomous Ownership : High agency, high ownership. We build systems that take control and make things better. We do the same: see it, own it, drive it. 😄 Cement it with Kindness & Fun : Have fun, be kind. We're here to extend Earth's life, but ours is still limited. We want to enjoy the ride. To see these in full, go to Gigaton’s Operating Principles Notion page. description: About LILT AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation. We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone , regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI. About the Role: As a Senior Technical Program Manager of Applied AI, you will sit at the intersection of cutting-edge research and industrial-scale execution. You will operate with an entrepreneurial mindset, effectively acting as the CEO of your customer's business to proactively drive success. You are responsible for leading complex benchmark transformations and data deliverables. High-Volume Data Operations: Architect and oversee pipelines for delivering high-volume data samples across multiple modalities (text, image, video, audio), ensuring strict adherence to delivery cadences without sacrificing precision. End-to-End Quality Control: Partner with production to implement rigorous, automated, and human-in-the-loop QC frameworks to ensure data integrity across various domains and languages. title: Robotaxi Technical Operations Manager
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Technical Operations Teams Wayve’s Technical Operations function is the critical bridge between Product, Engineering, and Operations. We thrive in dynamic, high-growth environments, turning complex technical strategies into actionable field operations that set the standard for autonomy at scale. 🧠 Your day-to-day You’ll stand up and run technical operations in new markets—planning data collection campaigns, preparing vehicles and operators for launch, and running live robotaxi services with our ridehail partners. Your work will build the feedback loops that convert on-road data, operator insights, and service metrics into continuous product enhancements, demonstrating improvements through live operations. You’ll drive the pace and reliability required to deliver commercial services where customer experience and operational reliability are measured daily. 🧩 What you’ll be working on Market launch readiness: Turn program plans into clear, actionable launch plans by market, covering vehicle commissioning, operator readiness, route and ODD validation, and safety sign-offs. Lead go/no-go reviews across multiple regions. Third-party operator performance: Manage operating relationships with subcontracted partners, set and review SLAs and performance standards, run audit cycles, and drive corrective actions. Operator standards and train-the-trainer: Partner with Training to ensure trainers are certified, curricula keep pace with releases, and operator competence is consistently assessed in every market. Release and change management: Coordinate how software and model releases reach the road, from operator briefings and in-car checks to staged rollouts and structured field feedback. Performance reporting: Own weekly product performance reporting—including autonomy time, pickups/drop-offs, km driven, and safety events—and turn trends into priority actions for Operations, Engineering, and Product. Field-to-model feedback loops: Be the link between on-road operations and model, product, and research teams. Triage on-road events, route insights, and design targeted testing to close data gaps. Scaling the playbook: Improve processes, SOPs, and tooling so each new market launches faster and more safely. 🙌 You should apply if Essential: Experience in technical program management or operations roles at the intersection of R&D, product development, and field testing in high-complexity environments (e.g., autonomous systems, robotics, aerospace, advanced mobility). Proven track record of managing programs, demonstrations, or operations that require close coordination between technical development teams and field execution. Experience managing third-party vendors or subcontractors against SLAs, including performance audits and corrective action plans. Deep experience with test planning, operational readiness frameworks, and structured field-to-technical feedback loops. Ability to influence across teams and geographies in fast-moving technology environments. Strong facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with experience leading cross-functional workshops and coordinating across Engineering, Science, Product, and Operations. Proficiency with operational data: defining metrics, creating/interpreting dashboards, and using them to identify bottlenecks. Clear written communication, including SOPs, launch checklists, and executive updates. Comfort with ambiguity and competing priorities. Willing to travel up to 30% across launch markets. Desirable: Experience in autonomous vehicles, advanced driver assistance systems, or rideshare/mobility marketplace operations. Background in safety management systems, incident investigation or operator competence frameworks. Experience with AV permitting or deployment in one or more markets. Comfortable with project management tools (e.g., Confluence, Asana/Jira) and implementing operational tracking systems. Knowledge of process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma) or operational excellence frameworks. Familiarity with vehicle commissioning, fleet management systems, or automotive safety protocols. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen - 30 mins Competency Interviews - 45 mins Deep-dive technical interviews - Case Study Presentation - 1 hour Final interview: mission & values alignment - 30 mins What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. title: Manager, Global Controls & Obligations Management, EMEA

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. How you'll make impact As Manager, Global Controls & Obligations Management, you’ll build and operate the framework that turns complex EMEA regulatory and partner obligations into practical, tested, and well-evidenced controls across Airwallex’s products, services, and regulated entities. You’ll sit within Regulatory Legal & Compliance and work closely with Regulatory Compliance, Regulatory Legal, Risk, Product, Operations, Finance, and external financial partners to strengthen a control environment that’s scalable, proportionate, and ready for regulatory scrutiny. This role is hands-on and execution-focused: you won’t just interpret rules, you’ll help design, implement, and continuously improve the controls, documentation, and reporting that demonstrate we’re meeting our obligations day to day. You’ll work across the broader global organization to identify gaps, clarify ownership, and embed consistent obligations-management practices across EMEA markets. Identify, interpret, and operationalize regulatory and partner obligations across EMEA jurisdictions, products, and regulated entities, translating them into clear governance, controls, and execution requirements. Support EMEA regulatory exams, audits, inspections, RFIs, and related supervisory engagements by coordinating responses, curating consistent evidence packages, maintaining exam-ready documentation, and partnering with Regulatory Compliance and Regulatory Legal. Contribute to the design and operation of EMEA regulatory reporting and obligations governance, ensuring that reporting requirements, ownership, timing, and source systems are clearly defined and appropriately controlled. Identify gaps, inconsistencies, or duplication across EMEA obligations, controls, and evidence, and drive pragmatic remediation or uplift plans that balance regulatory expectations, partner requirements, and business impact. Help establish consistent obligations-management practices that can scale with Airwallex’s EMEA business and align with the broader global regulatory operating model. This role is remote in the EMEA region. What we're looking for We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory. Essentials 7+ years of experience in regulatory operations, regulatory compliance, internal audit, risk management, or a similar discipline within a fast-growing technology company and/or financial services, payments, or fintech company. Proven experience translating legal, regulatory, or partner requirements into operational controls, procedures, and testing or assurance activities, not just policy drafting. Direct involvement in supporting regulatory exams, audits, inspections, RFIs, or partner due-diligence reviews, with clear personal ownership for planning, coordination, documentation, or remediation workstreams. Strong project management skills, with a track record of driving cross-functional control or reporting initiatives to completion across Product, Operations, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Risk. Excellent analytical and writing skills, with the ability to turn complex regulatory concepts into clear, concise control requirements and exam-ready materials. Comfort operating in a fast-moving, high-standards environment with evolving priorities and meaningful cross-functional ownership. Preferred Experience with payments, e-money, card issuing or acquiring, treasury, embedded finance, or other multi-jurisdiction fintech business models. Prior exposure to EMEA regulators and regulatory frameworks, as well as European bank, financial institution, or card scheme partners on control or reporting topics. Experience building or enhancing obligations registers, control libraries, regulatory reporting operating models, or similar second-line compliance infrastructure. Familiarity with GRC or similar tooling to manage obligations, controls, issues, and evidence at scale. Relevant professional certifications, such as CAMS, CRCM, CIA, or CISA, or formal legal, compliance, risk, or audit-related education. You'll thrive here if You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it. You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details. You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it. You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA. Learn more about your team Regulatory & Compliance is where we build the trust, discipline, and operational resilience required to scale a generational financial platform. As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. title: Strategy & Operations Senior Manager, Consumer
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. About the Team The Consumer Core team at Deliveroo owns the in-app experience and how consumers explore our product. Our mission is to help consumers build confidence in ordering and discover "the best in their neighborhood." Our team identifies emerging customer needs, shapes long-term strategy for the consumer food discovery journey, and ensures that new features deliver measurable impact. Ultimately, we advocate for the consumer at every step, championing experiences that make Deliveroo feel local, relevant, and delightful. About the Role In this role, you will establish and lead the operating rhythm of the EMEA Consumer organization across Deliveroo and Wolt—shaping how we manage weekly business performance, plan for the quarters and years ahead, and deploy investment to deliver ambitious, profitable growth. You'll work closely with colleagues across Finance, Marketing, and Operations to lead quarterly and annual planning, weekly business reviews, and investment proposal approvals. You will manage in-quarter budgets, track performance against our outlook, and recommend where to increase investment or pull back to achieve our growth and profitability goals. You will also take ownership of high-priority, cross-functional projects where there is no obvious owner—from growth sprints to new partner launches. You'll be accountable from initial diagnosis and recommendation through implementation and results, getting into the detail while keeping the broader business objectives in view. Ultimately, your work will help the Consumer organization make better decisions, execute more effectively, and put investment behind the opportunities with the greatest impact. You will report into the Director of Consumer Strategy and Behavior, within the broader consumer organization. You're excited about this opportunity because you will… Strategize – Shape our team's strategy and help decide "what we should do next" Build – Design and launch new initiatives from the ground up Analyze – Analyze experiment results to inform business decisions and future experiments Influence – Partner with other teams - Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Analytics - to drive cross-functional and go-to-market execution What You'll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others: Strategic & Analytical Depth: Significant experience in product, consulting, investment banking, or technology environments with a proven ability to build insight-driven models and solve complex problems. Stakeholder Influence: Strong understanding of how to build trust and drive alignment across diverse senior Commercial and Technology leaders. Complex Project Management: Proven ability to manage large-scale projects from scoping to execution, maintaining momentum across multiple functions and markets. Entrepreneurial Drive: A bias for action and a comfort with ambiguity, with the proactivity to build and iterate where playbooks are still being defined. Structured Communication: Ability to drive clarity through structured, confident communication, translating data into compelling narratives for both upwards and downwards influence. Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 🔧 Make a visible impact every day – Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders. 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment – Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility. 🧠 Build a career, not just a role – Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves. 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture – Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best. title: AI Client Executive
