With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3777 - Associate, Data Engineering, UK</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>DTA is WPP’s global data products and technology arm. We’re on a mission to transform marketing by building the fastest, most connected data platform that bridges marketing strategy to scaled activation.</p> <p>We work with agencies and clients to transform the value of data by bringing together technology, data and analytics capabilities. We deliver this through the Open Media Studio, an AI-enabled media and data platform for the next era of advertising.</p> <p>We’re endlessly curious. Our team of thinkers, builders, creators and problem solvers are over 1,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world.</p> <p> As <strong>Associate, Data Engineering</strong><strong> </strong>you will be joining the WPP Media BI and Data Management team.</p> <p>You will work with the Measure data platform – a unified system for data connection, ingestion, transformation, and reporting – built on a robust technology stack including Adverity, GCP, and PowerBI. In this role, you will support client projects that aggregate diverse data sources into a single, unified view, helping to ensure data integrity and consistency to enable comprehensive insights. Under the guidance of senior team members, you will focus on understanding specific client requirements and learning to develop visualisations that deliver on them.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities </strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the development of bespoke data solutions within the BI team, contributing to the delivery of high-quality business intelligence and data visualisations by setting up automated data pipelines and transformations.</li> <li>Collaborate with planning teams and senior BI colleagues to help translate business specifications into technical requirements.</li> <li>Assist in ensuring data integrity and consistency by executing queries and validating the accuracy and completeness of data.</li> <li>Help develop and maintain dashboarding solutions using Power BI, including basic troubleshooting and performance optimization.</li> <li>Develop a strong foundational understanding of digital advertising and ad serving technology (e.g., ad serving, vendor ad servers, web analytics, attribution).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.</li> <li>Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.</li> <li>Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Essential </strong></p> <ul> <li>Foundational experience or academic project work involving bringing disparate datasets together in data visualisations.</li> <li>Hands-on experience or coursework working with Power BI.</li> <li>A basic understanding of data modelling, data integrity challenges, and general best practices.</li> <li>Strong willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable </strong></p> <ul> <li>Basic exposure to Cloud platforms: GCP (preferred) or others.</li> <li>Experience with using SQL, Python and other languages to query, analyse, or transform data.</li> <li>Basic understanding of digital marketing and/or web analytics data.</li> <li>Exposure to DBT (Data Build Tool).</li> <li>Familiarity with collaboration tools such as Jira or Confluence.</li> <li>Exposure to working in a technical team that uses Agile/Scrum methodologies.</li> <li>Basic understanding of version control tools like GitHub/GitLab.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.</p> <p><em>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</em></p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p> </p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. </p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Chief of Staff, Global Sales
description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <div class="p-rich_text_section">Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit <a class="c-link" href="http://www.redditinc.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://redditinc.com" data-sk="tooltip_parent">www.redditinc.com</a>.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div></div><p>As the Chief of Staff to the EVP of Global Ad Sales, you will serve as a high-leverage strategic operator, executive proxy, and force multiplier across the Global Sales Organization (GSO). Your key function is to scale executive attention, accelerate decision velocity, and translate GSO’s highest strategic priorities into clear execution and follow-through.</p> <p>The ideal Chief of Staff operates with high EQ to maintain Reddit’s open, collaborative, and accessible culture while ensuring that executive time is prioritized for high-impact drivers. You will partner closely with Sales Strategy & Operations, regional sales leadership, and cross-functional executive teams to orchestrate a seamless operational rhythm and drive global alignment.</p> <p><strong>This role is required to be based in New York or London.</strong></p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li><em>Drive Alignment & Prioritization</em></li> <ul> <li><strong>Filter & Route Inquiries:</strong> Establish clear operational paths for routine data requests, incident reporting, and tactical items below the executive level, freeing leadership bandwidth for major revenue initiatives.</li> <li><strong>Executive Proxy & Strategic Alignment:</strong> Represent the EVP in key cross-functional leadership forums, planning reviews, and offsites, building bottoms-up consensus and alignment before issues require top-down intervention.</li> <li><strong>Surface Field Signals:</strong> Synthesize customer sentiment, competitive dynamics, and field feedback directly from front-line sales teams to keep executive leadership deeply connected to market realities.</li> <li><strong>Pre-Frame Executive Decisions:</strong> Ensure material revenue proposals and strategic escalations reaching the EVP are pre-framed with clear context and explicit recommendations, allowing leadership to focus on high-order strategic decisions.</li> </ul> <li><em>Operational Rhythm & Business Cadence</em></li> <ul> <li><strong>Orchestrate Business Cadence: </strong>Maintain the global sales operational rhythm, including leadership reviews, quarterly business reviews, strategic offsites, and key team communication forums, ensuring priorities are proactively tracked and fire drills are minimized.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Alignment with Sales Strategy & Operations:</strong> Partner seamlessly with Sales Strategy & Operations by translating strategic outputs into operational workstreams, leadership narratives, and review frameworks.</li> <li><strong>Executive Communications & Collateral:</strong> Drive end-to-end preparation of strategic collateral, executive presentations, board materials, and organizational communications in close coordination with Internal Comms partners.</li> </ul> <li><em>Track Strategic Priorities & Follow-Through</em></li> <ul> <li><strong>Track & Report on Key Commercial Initiatives:</strong> Track high-priority commercial initiatives and global sales bets, ensuring every key initiative has a clearly defined owner, success metrics, and milestones.</li> <li><strong>Accountability & Execution:</strong> Ensure regional and functional leaders leave executive reviews with clear action items and deadlines; track ongoing performance against overarching organization priorities.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Initiative Support:</strong> Drive alignment and operational support for complex, multi-functional sales initiatives across GTM, Product, Marketing, and SS&O. </li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications: </strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of relevant experience in a Sales/revenue/business strategy & operations role within an ad sales organization</li> <li>Deep understanding of the rhythm of the business in a high-growth environment</li> <li>Exceptional problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to synthesize complex data/insights and build actionable strategies around the highest impact opportunities</li> <li>Outstanding communication and relationship building skills, with the ability to build trust and influence across all levels</li> <li>Proven track record of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment</li> <li>Results-oriented and committed to driving measurable impact</li> <li>Innovative operator, accustomed to leveraging technology (i.e. AI, tooling), to scale, improve and help the team operate more effectively</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Ideal Candidate:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Believes in Reddit’s mission</li> <li>Is organized and can build their own structure</li> <li>Is a strong communicator</li> <li>Is an optimist</li> <li>Is humble</li> <li>Can effectively communicate with everyone from engineers to sales </li> <li>Is fact-based, and willing to be hypothesis-driven</li> <li>Needs limited guidance and no instruction manual</li> <li>Acts as a force multiplier vs. a barrier to their executive partner</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support</li> <li>Family Planning Support </li> <li>Gender-Affirming Care</li> <li>Mental Health & Coaching Benefits</li> <li>Group Personal Pension Scheme with Employer match</li> <li>Private Medical and Dental Scheme</li> <li>Income Replacement Programs</li> <li>Bike to Work scheme</li> <li>Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off</li> <li>Generous Paid Parental Leave</li> </ul> <p><span You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. title: Lab Technician
description: Halo is a technology company building the future of haircare for all textures through exceptional engineering and human-centered design. We create category-defining products built for the complexities others overlook. We're building HaloBraid, the world’s first braid assist device. It helps stylists finish braids 5 times faster, flawlessly and gently. This is one of the hardest unsolved problems in robotics, applied to a $270B salon services industry, and integrating computer vision, compliant fiber manipulation, and novel mechanisms. Billions of hours are spent braiding hair each year. HaloBraid gives that time back. We’re moving from R&D into deployment with salons, and backed by leading investors Seven Seven Six, AlleyCorp, and Bling Capital. Responsibilities: Assembling, manufacturing and modifying mechanical and electronic components and assemblies. Building and developing engineering systems and prototypes. Supporting research and development activities, including testing and data analysis. Supporting equipment maintenance and servicing. Collaborate with mechanical, industrial design, electrical, and manufacturing engineers, users, and cross-functional teams. Managing inventory and maintaining build and component records Requirements Practical mechanical and electronic engineering skills, including assembly and component modification. Great problem-solving skills with an analytical and logical approach. The ability to work independently and collaboratively within an engineering team. A proactive approach to improving working methods and maintaining safe, organised workshop environments. Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate build guides and test records. Experience or knowledge of electronic soldering, printed circuit board assembly and cable or wire harness manufacturing. Desired Skills & Experience (optional but the more, the better) Experience with various prototyping and manufacturing methods such as 3D printing, machining, lasercutting, casting, injection molding, and welding. Experience with robotics, mechanisms, mechatronics, and moving components. Experience with CAD systems and mechanical design. Experience with jig and fixture design. Working Style User centric, you want to build stuff people use and love Low ego, adaptable, and collaborative spirit Excited to learn through fast-paced iteration and user feedback Passionate, driven by innovation Great communication, an ability to concisely convey and discuss complex ideas Benefits of Working with Us: We offer a competitive salary, 28 days holiday + bank holidays and a range of other benefits. Onsite Work This is an onsite position in the UK at the Paintworks in Bristol's creative quarter. This position closes on December 7th 2026 for review. Don’t Meet Every Requirement? title: VP Data & AI Platform Engineering
description: What we’re all about. Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all. We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us. The opportunity. Quantexa’s largest customer engagements are now enterprise platform transformations, and we want to replicate that success across strategic customers globally. We are establishing a dedicated platform function for the first time, and we are looking for a player-manager to lead it. Reporting to the SVP of Data & AI Platform Solutions, you will build and lead a small, senior, global team of platform architects. You will shape how Quantexa takes its Data & AI and Context Layer propositions to market, and you will personally lead support our most strategic pursuits, supporting large platform deployments from early technical engagement and proof of concept through to value realisation and expansion. Success means more platform deals won, larger and faster-moving pursuits, and customers who expand their use of the platform after go-live. That track record is what will earn the team its growth. The role is greenfield: you will define what the function owns, how it works and how it scales within the context of the wider operating model. What You’ll Be Doing Win strategic platform deals Lead the technical and business narrative on targeted global accounts, working alongside field engineers and sales. Map the customer’s enterprise ecosystem, uncover high-value use cases and data, build the business case for enterprise platforms and context layer, and take get buy-in from it to the C-suite. Shape platform propositions and build support for transformational deals Define and sharpen Quantexa’s platform propositions for target industries and buyer personas, drawing on what we learn in live customer engagements. Give technical input to platform market positioning and messaging for the platform and context layer, working with Marketing so that what we say in the market is credible and differentiated. Build the support that transformational deals need: executive narratives, reference architectures, business case materials and proof-of-concept approaches. Make these reusable across accounts. Present the propositions at customer and industry events, as a credible technical voice on enterprise data platforms and agentic AI. Work with the Alliances team, Marketing and Product so that partner and technology-ecosystem conversations reinforce the propositions. Connect customer needs to platform strategy and the product roadmap Identify the features, capability gaps and needs that customers and deals expose, and use them to inform platform strategy. Define platform requirements and work closely with Product Management to ensure the necessary changes are incorporated into the product roadmap. Test new platform uses, including agentic AI and the Context Layer, with Product Innovation and Delivery, and help turn proven ideas into market validated and technically de-risked features as candidates for introduction into product. Build the demos and integrations that show customers the value. Build and lead the team Set the direction and standards for a global team of platform architects, and coach and develop them. Launch the team with three new approved roles and use early wins to secure investment for further growth. Shape how the team works with Field Engineering and regional account teams, and where it focuses its effort in line with strategic priorities. Create a repeatable platform method Own the methodology and toolkit that take a customer from a first use case to wider platform adoption. Work with the Enablement and Marketing teams to enable partners, customers and colleagues to run platform engagements themselves for self-sufficiency in applying best practice approaches for platform and context layer – contributing content and helping coordinate execution. What you’ll bring? A record of C-suite, business and technical engagement, including running executive workshops. Experience managing and influencing teams of architects and developing senior technical talent. The ability to work with Product and Marketing: you can turn customer needs into clear requirements and explain technical differentiation to a market audience. The agility of a player-manager: you can lead a senior executive meeting in the morning and be hands-on with a design or demo in the afternoon. Broad architecture experience: enterprise architecture, for vision and roadmaps solution architecture, for shaping opportunities data architecture, for designing data products The technical depth to be credible with CTOs, CDOs and Chief Architects on data integration, platform architecture and secure deployment models. Hands-on building experience. You can design systems and have built non-trivial components, ideally with AI coding tools such as Claude. Nice to have Experience of the Databricks or Snowflake ecosystems, or of hyperscaler data platforms. Experience supporting large programmes delivered with systems integrators. Experience of building a new function or team. Experience in a product-facing role, such as defining requirements or contributing to a roadmap. Our perks and quirks. What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits. We offer: Competitive salary & Company bonus 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off! Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%) Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover Life Insurance and Income Protection Regularly bench-marked salary rates Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave Well-being days Volunteer Day off Work from Home Equipment Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app Continuous Training and Development Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials Our mission. We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future. title: Product Marketing Lead
description: Product Marketing Lead Reporting to: CMO Location: London (hybrid, 4 days a week in the office) Salary: £80,000-£100,000 + equity About Electric Twin Most organisations make their biggest decisions on a thin slice of evidence - a handful of customer calls, one survey, instinct when the data runs out. Electric Twin changes that. We build synthetic audiences: simulations of real groups of people, grounded in research data. Teams ask them questions, test ideas and explore how people might respond, and get answers in minutes that would otherwise take weeks. The work is grounded, and the science is real. We've run over 40,000 evaluations across populations covering 155 countries. Independent academic research with Professor Michael Muthukrishna at the LSE found our outputs come back roughly 10,000x faster than traditional methods, at 95% accuracy. Customers including The Times, Sage, Virgin, Vodafone and Wingstop use Electric Twin to bring customer insight into decisions about campaigns, products, pricing and strategy. Electric Twin was founded by Dr Ben Warner (former Chief Data Advisor to the UK Prime Minister) and our CEO, Alex Cooper (a former senior military commander and Director of Mass Covid Testing in the pandemic). We're backed by Atomico, LocalGlobe, Mercuri and angels including Marc Andreessen. We're a team of engineers, AI researchers, behavioural scientists and operators - careful with the science, careful with the responsibility. The role We're hiring a Product Marketing Lead to own product marketing at Electric Twin, from the strategy through to the sales deck. Our ambition is to make understanding people a normal part of making decisions. Product marketing is central to that. It's how we decide who Electric Twin is for, what we compete against and why a buyer should choose us, and how that story reaches the market through our product, our website and our sales team. Next year is a big one. We're launching in new markets, taking Electric Twin to more parts of a business, and bringing more products to market. We need someone who has operated at this level before, and who can join the dots between sales, marketing and product. Product marketing here covers four areas: insights, storytelling, go-to-market and enablement. You'll own all four, and decide where to lean in as the company grows. You'll work closely with our CMO, our VP Product and our sales team. Our Growth Lead runs the engine - the channels and programmes that reach and convert our audience. Product marketing and content provide the fuel. You'll own positioning and messaging. Our Content Lead will turn it into stories and get them out across every channel. This is a hands-on role. You'll set the strategy, and you'll also write the launch plan, the value proposition brief and the sales deck yourself. What’s exciting - you’re the founding PMM and get to build out and lead this function as we expand. What you'll do Insights Be the expert on our customer. We have strong customer research, a map of what customers want to use the product for and a regular round-up of the questions they ask. Build on it, keep it current and make sure the rest of the business uses it. Understand the buyers we're growing into. Our buyer today is the insights team. Marketing, product and commercial teams come next. Speak to them, define who they are and work out what they need to hear from us. Know the market. This is a fast-moving category, with research incumbents launching their own products and a new batch of innovators arriving. Track it, and keep a clear, committed point of view on how Electric Twin is different. Bring an opinion to product strategy. Work with our VP Product on the value proposition, and bring the customer and the market into decisions about what we build. Storytelling Own our positioning and messaging. Keep one consistent way of describing what Electric Twin is, who it is for and why a buyer should choose it, used by sales, product and marketing. Own the trust story. Trust is central to how buyers choose us. Own how we prove it: the evidence, the customer stories and the guidance for prospects who want to evaluate us for themselves. Turn the product into language a buyer would use. Take what we build and describe it in the customer's words, across the website, the product and our sales materials. Shape the story for new markets and buyers. Build and adjust the narrative for our new market launches, and for the teams beyond insight and research that we want to reach. Go-to-market Set the product narrative. Agree a product narrative each quarter with our VP Product, so every launch adds up to a bigger story. Run our launches. Build a tiered launch process so the effort matches the size of the release, and run it with product, sales and marketing. Take Electric Twin to new buyers and markets. Plan how we go to market in the US, in new verticals and with new teams inside our customers. Improve the buyer journey on our website. Work with growth, content and design so the site shows the product and has something for visitors who aren't yet ready to talk to sales. Enablement Equip our sales team. A sales deck built on our positioning, battlecards for the alternatives that come up most, ROI material for the economic buyer and a pack our champions can take to their senior stakeholders. Build a working relationship with sales. Agree priorities together, with one route in for requests and a short brief for each. Train sales and CX. Run onboarding and regular training on our positioning, product, use cases and objection handling, so both teams can explain our value and help customers get the most from Electric Twin. Build feedback loops across teams. Create regular workflows that bring sales objections, win/loss insights and CX feedback into product priorities, positioning and enablement. Take updates back to those teams and check whether they solve the problems raised. Be an advocate inside the business. Present to the company, and represent the customer and the product in the conversations that matter. You need to be the central point between Sales, Marketing and Product and drive the strategy proactively to each - ultimately for the benefit of the customer. Build our product marketing operating system. Bring our research, positioning and messaging into one managed source of truth that feeds the tools used across product, sales, customer success and internal comms. Use AI to build repeatable workflows on top of it and keep it updated. Your first six months Take our positioning and messaging and get it into the website, sales enablement and our core external-facing materials. Agree the first quarterly product narrative with our VP Product, and get a tiered launch process running. Rebuild sales enablement, with battlecards, ROI material and a pack for champions. Define the marketing buyer and build the narrative for our new market launches. Get the product marketing operating system up and running. What we're looking for Experience At least five years in product marketing alone. You've done this role before, ideally growing a product in a similar space or selling to an enterprise audience. You've owned positioning and messaging, and taken it through to a website and sales materials that people used. You've run product launches with a product team, and worked closely with a sales team on what they need to win deals. You've partnered with senior product and commercial leaders, and you're as comfortable having an opinion on product strategy as on sales and commercial strategy. You understand the tools and techniques of the trade, including Jobs-to-be-done and know how to define messaging and positioning. Skills and approach Autonomous. You can own the strategy and ship the copy without much steering. . A good writer, and strong at the content specific to product marketing, such as sales decks and value proposition briefs. A strong communicator. You can present internally and be an advocate for the customer and the product. Curious and proactive. You know what you don't know, you read up or ask for help, and you act on problems once you've spotted them. You've used AI to build repeatable workflows, and you can judge when the output is good enough and when it isn't. You can operate in a fast-paced environment that has ambiguity. You work with a sense of urgency, you raise issues as they arise and you anticipate problems Careful with the details. You're comfortable getting to grips with AI, research and technical subjects, you ask good questions and you check claims carefully. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. What you'll be working on: Designing and operating distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native services. Building maintainable systems following Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, and similar architectural principles. title: Implementation Specialist (Aveni Assist)
description: About Aveni Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build real, production-ready agentic systems that reshape how banks, advisers and financial services firms operate, replacing fragmented processes with intelligent, end-to-end workflows. We have been recognised as Fintech of the Year for two consecutive years and awarded Best Specialist Technology Service at the Professional Adviser Awards 2025. Backed by leading investors including Puma Private Equity, and commercially supported by Lloyds Banking Group and Nationwide Building Society, we previously completed one of Scotland's largest Series A rounds. Since then, we've continued to grow rapidly as adoption of AI in financial services accelerates, and we're now scaling our team to meet that demand. The Role Aveni Assist is our AI-powered platform for financial advice firms. It helps advisers and paraplanners automate documentation, improve compliance and spend more time with clients. We're looking for an Implementation Specialist to help new clients get live on Assist and make it part of how they deliver advice every day. You'll work with firms from the moment they sign, learning how they run their advice process and configuring Assist to match: from suitability report templates to the quality assurance criteria their compliance teams rely on. If you've worked as a paraplanner or in a similar role and want to use that knowledge to shape how AI is adopted across the advice market, this role is for you. What You'll Be Doing Running discovery with clients to understand their objectives, advice processes, documentation, CRM workflows and quality assurance frameworks, and turning these into clear requirements and deliverables. Creating and managing implementation plans covering milestones, responsibilities, dependencies and timescales, and acting as a primary point of contact for your clients. Building, configuring and refining AI-driven document templates so outputs match each firm's structure, style, regulatory expectations and internal standards. Working with clients to define quality assessment questions, scoring criteria, evidence requirements and edge cases, then coordinating testing and refining the configuration. Acting as the link between clients and Aveni's Product and Engineering teams, coordinating technical readiness and helping investigate issues. Supporting user onboarding with our Enablement team, coordinating go-live readiness and providing early-life support before handing over to Customer Success and Support. Gathering usage data and client feedback, sharing product insights with Product and Engineering, and contributing to our implementation playbooks and the Assist roadmap. What We're Looking For Experience as a Paraplanner or in a similar role within a financial planning or wealth management firm. A strong understanding of suitability reports, advice processes, CRM systems, adviser-client conversations and FCA-regulated environments. Experience working with clients in a SaaS or software environment. Excellent written and verbal communication, with confidence leading client calls, workshops and training sessions. Strong organisation and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple clients and deliverables at once. Excellent attention to detail and analytical problem-solving, particularly around advice documentation, data accuracy and regulatory requirements. Comfort learning and configuring software, and an adaptable approach to taking ownership in an evolving environment. Nice to Have Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment. Experience using AI tools or digital platforms. Experience supporting client onboarding, implementation, change management or an early-stage product rollout. Experience planning or supporting user acceptance testing. Familiarity with software configuration, technical analysis or CRM integrations. Why Join Aveni? You'll take the advice-process knowledge you've built and use it to shape how AI is adopted across the UK advice market. You'll work directly with a wide range of advice firms, see the impact of your work on how advisers and paraplanners spend their time, and have a real voice in how Aveni Assist develops. Familiar with HubSpot, Zapier, and basic no-code automation. Bonus: Working proficiency with SQL. Bonus: Exposure to Financial Promotions or regulated industries. Mindset & Working Style Analytical and data-driven - comfortable making decisions from performance metrics. Proactive and self-starting working with speed and autonomy.  Use AI tools and automation to enhance efficiency and results.  A fast learner who thrives in high-growth, fast-moving environments. title: Senior Account Manager (French-speaking)
description: Who are we At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Drive account expansion: Identify and execute upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities, leading commercial conversations and negotiations with a focus on achieving and surpassing sales quotas. Navigate complex enterprise sales processes: Coordinate multi-stakeholder opportunities, procurement activity, contract negotiations, and legal discussions, ensuring progress toward successful commercial outcomes. Partner cross-functionally and maintain accurate reporting: Work closely with Customer Success and Solutions Architecture to support retention and expansion, collaborate with Product, Finance, and Legal to resolve customer needs, and maintain accurate CRM records, account plans, pipeline updates, and forecasts. Use AI to elevate your work: Proactively explore and apply AI tools and approaches to improve customer research, account planning, decision-making, productivity, and go-to-market impact. Proven commercial outcomes: A track record of protecting customer revenue, achieving gross revenue retention or comparable retention targets, and generating measurable account expansion. Professional fluency in French , including the ability to lead customer conversations, presentations, and commercial negotiations in French. Ability to understand complex SaaS products, with experience selling to business, marketing, and sales stakeholders , and translating product capabilities into clear commercial value. Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across a remote, international organisation. title: Principal Data Scientist
description: At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world. The Role The Data Science team at CoMind develops the algorithms and machine learning systems that transform raw optical interference signals from CoMind One into continuous, clinically meaningful measurements of cerebral blood flow, intracranial pressure, and autoregulation. Working at the frontier of photonics, physiology, and applied ML, the team's work directly determines what CoMind One can measure, how accurately, and under what clinical conditions. As Principal Data Scientist, you will be a technical authority for CoMind's data science function, setting methodological direction for signal condition and extraction, personally driving the most complex and highest-impact problems, and providing expert guidance on data science best practice across the team. This is a senior individual contributor role: you will not manage people directly, but your technical leadership will shape how the entire team approaches its most challenging problems. You will work closely with R&D, Clinical, and Software Engineering. At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day. Responsibilities: Act as the technical authority for the end-to-end signal processing and inference chain for CoMind’s technologies: from raw optical data through to clinical measurements Set the methodological direction for estimation, signal extraction and ML modelling across the team: which approaches suit which problems, how they are evaluated, and what evidence is required before a method is trusted. Own signal processing and analysis programmes from research through to validated, production-quality implementations with Software Engineering. Derive achievable performance bounds from instrument and noise models, and use them to drive algorithm selection, requirement setting and design trade-offs Own how the team handles uncertainty and calibration — inference methods appropriate to small clinical cohorts, per-patient estimation with quantified uncertainty, and calibration strategies that make measurements comparable across devices, sessions and patients. Set the standard for how the data science function works: reproducibility, analysis and code review, experiment design, dataset governance and ground-truth definitions Act as the primary technical reviewer and expert resource across the research organisation, reviewing technical reports, analysis plans and evaluation methodology, and holding the bar for methodological rigour and scientific integrity. Identify and introduce new, best-practice methods from estimation, inference and measurement science in adjacent fields. Act as a mentor to members of the Data Science teams and across the wider business Contribute to CoMind's IP and publication strategy, authoring and reviewing technical papers, patent applications and regulatory documents. AI is fundamental to our culture. It's not just a tool, but a core part of how we work, collaborate, and innovate. We expect all team members to embrace AI in their daily work and continuously find new ways to use it effectively. Skills & Experience: 15+ years of experience in data science, ML, or applied research, with a strong track record of independent technical leadership on complex, ambiguous problems A career working to extract small signals from noisy, complex physiological systems, and developing and deploying physical models of those systems to support those efforts. Deep expertise in physiological time-series signal processing methodologies. A demonstrated ability to take algorithmic work from research concept through to production-quality, validated implementations in shipped product. Designing device performance evaluation methods where no prior gold-standard exists: simulating physical systems, running sensitivity analysis, identifying failure modes, and developing signal processing solutions to address those challenges. title: Senior Finance Business Partner - Marketing (6-month FTC)
description: About Freetrade Freetrade’s mission is to become the default place to invest. Investing has been too complicated and expensive for too long, keeping millions from making the most of their savings. We’re changing that. We’re building our team and looking for people who are excited to reshape how our customers invest and grow their wealth. If you’re driven by solving complex problems and building innovative products, you’ll fit right in. 2026 is a big year for us. Last year, we announced a game changing deal to become part of the IG Group. We’ll continue to operate as an independent business while gaining access to the resources and support of an established leader in the space. This year, we’re accelerating our roadmap and taking our products to the next level. We’re building new features like mutual funds, bonds, and family investment tools. We’re also exploring how we can leverage AI to deliver an even better experience for our customers. Why join the Commercial Finance team at Freetrade? You will be joining a small Commercial Finance team on a 6-month Fixed Term Contract (FTC) as Freetrade enters the ‘scale-up’ phase of its business. Our team is evolving from an FP&A reporting team to a commercial-oriented business partnering team. You will be providing commercial insight through impactful and insightful analysis to influence executive-level decision-making. You will report to the Head of Commercial Finance. You will: Partner with our marketing leadership team, along with additional central departments Proactively highlight opportunities for efficiency, evaluating value for money, reviewing paybacks, CACs and ROIs Provide commercial challenge and recommendations, from both data analysis and competitor scanning Seek continuous improvement in reporting, finding areas for automation and opportunities to create self-serve dashboards Own the annual budget for your area along with monthly reporting against budget Forecast headcount spend in partnership with department heads in order to drive hiring decisions Forecast vendor-level spend, track renewal dates and run supplier negotiations Prepare models for business cases, projecting costs and impact for new products, new suppliers and new operations Experience: Recognised accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) with 5+ years of relevant experience, including 3+ years as a Finance Business Partner. Experience working in financial services/fintech or similar industries Experience of business partnering with a marketing function Experience in building financial models and conducting scenario analysis About you: A proactive, self-motivated problem solver An effective communicator with the ability to build strong relationships across all levels of the company An interest in the investments industry Highly numerate Benefits & Logistics Freetrade is the place to accelerate your career. Our benefits package and ways of working are designed to attract and retain the most talented people who are dedicated to making an impact at Freetrade. Here’s what’s on offer in 2026: Hybrid working culture We’re operating in a hybrid model: 3-days in-office / 2-days from home . We believe great collaboration happens in person and our beautiful offices in central London and Budapest are designed to bring people together. 🏢 Office days: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday 🏡 Work from home days: Wednesday, Friday This setup helps us stay connected, collaborate more effectively, and keep building a culture where we all do our best work together, including dedicated days for focus work. Flexibility for those who need it : We have a hybrid working model, but life happens. If you need flexibility let's talk about it, whether you're a parent or have other care responsibilities. Values - at Freetrade we live and breathe our values: Honesty, Focus and Grit. Expect to be asked about these in your interview! Benefits In London: Competitive salary – carefully benchmarked. Holidays – 25 days plus UK public holidays. Your birthday off, plus one extra day for every year at Freetrade. Enhanced pension – We’ll match your contributions up to 7%. Group Life Insurance – Protect your loved ones with coverage at 5x your salary, ensuring financial security in any circumstance. Private Health Insurance - Which includes access to high quality medical care, mental health support, dental and vision plans, Wellness programs and preventative care initiatives are also provided to ensure the wellbeing of your entire family. Bonus Scheme - join us and share in our growth. Bonuses are linked to both company success and your individual impact. Income Protection Cover – Safeguard your income with comprehensive coverage, ensuring financial stability in the event of illness or injury. Enhanced parental leave – Time off when it matters most. ** Eligibility is subject to length of service and statutory requirements. Flexibility for those who need it – We’re office-first, but life happens. Whether you’re a parent or have care responsibilities, we focus on output and trust you to manage your time. Learning & Development – We fund industry qualifications so you can grow as a financial services professional. Cycle to Work scheme – Get a high quality bike and gear through our salary sacrifice scheme, spreading the cost with tax free monthly installments. Paid Sick Leave – Receive 10 days of fully paid sick leave each calendar year. Interview Process We keep things simple and transparent. Our process typically includes: Initial interview – A chat with one of our Talent Partners. Hiring Manager interview – A deep dive into your skills and experience. title: Sales Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 London | 💰 £60k – £80k base salary | £100k – £135k OTE  + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits">Benefits</a></p> <h3><strong>Our Monzo Business team ⭐</strong></h3> <p>Monzo Business helps businesses manage their money, and more than a million businesses (1 in 6!) in the UK bank with us. Now, we’re exploring how we can help more established businesses switch to Monzo, across the UK and Europe 🚀</p> <p>Many of those businesses have more complex needs. They may need help understanding whether Monzo is right for them, moving their banking or getting the most from our products. A great conversation with the right person can make a real difference.</p> <p>We’ve started building a sales team and testing a more personal approach. Now we’re looking for a Sales Manager to lead a team of Account Executives and help us turn what we’re learning into a repeatable, effective sales motion.</p> <p>This is a chance to build something new. You’ll coach your team, help them deliver great results and use what you see every day to make the way we sell better. You’ll work closely with Revenue Operations (RevOps), Product and other teams to improve our processes and customer journeys.</p> <p>You’ll also help build an AI-first sales motion from the start. We want someone who’s curious about AI and automation, actively experiments with new tools and can help the team spend more time on conversations that matter.</p> <h3><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Leading a team of Account Executives.</strong> Manage a pod of 6–8 people and be accountable for its performance, from reaching the right businesses and converting opportunities to customer activation and quality. Translate the wider Business strategy and set clear expectations, understand what’s driving results and act when performance needs to improve.</li> <li><strong>Coaching and developing your team.</strong> Spend time listening to calls, reviewing opportunities and giving clear, regular feedback. Help each person build their skills and confidence, recognise great work and address underperformance fairly. Help hire and onboard new team members as we grow.</li> <li><strong>Building the sales motion.</strong> Turn what you and your team learn into better ways of working. Spot friction in lead handling, follow-up, handovers and the sales process; test improvements, measure their impact and share what works so we can build a repeatable playbook.</li> <li><strong>Staying close to customers.</strong> We expect Sales Managers to also take a few sales calls each week and make a few sales a month. Use what you learn from customers and the sales journey to coach the team, identify product needs and improve the motion. Most of your time will be spent leading the team and improving how we work.</li> <li><strong>Helping shape our Products.</strong> Share what you learn from customers with Product to help shape our proposition and priorities, and use what we learn to improve how we sell.</li> <li><strong>Putting AI and automation to work.</strong> Experiment with tools, agents and workflows that help the team research prospects, prepare for conversations, follow up or learn from calls. Work with specialist teams to test ideas responsibly, understand their impact and help the team adopt what works.</li> <li><strong>Making good decisions with data.</strong> Use pipeline, conversion, activation, productivity and quality data to understand where the team is doing well and where customers or opportunities are getting stuck. Keep the pipeline accurate and work with RevOps on reporting and forecasting.</li> <li><strong>Working as one team.</strong> Bring frontline insight to RevOps, Product, Marketing and Operations. Help shape the tools, processes and customer journeys Sales needs, and work together to solve problems that affect your team and customers.</li> <li><strong>Earning customers’ trust.</strong> Build a culture that puts customers first. Coach your team to understand their needs, represent Monzo accurately and deliver good outcomes. Raise concerns early and work with Risk, Compliance and Legal when needed.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You’ve managed and developed a sales team. You can share examples of how you’ve coached individuals, given feedback and improved performance, including when conversations were difficult.</li> <li>You understand selling to small and medium-sized businesses in a relatively high-volume environment. You can balance an efficient process with thoughtful, customer-focused conversations.</li> <li>You’re a builder. You’ve spotted a problem in how a team sells, tried a better approach and helped people put it into practice. You’re comfortable making progress when the playbook is still being written.</li> <li>You’ve actively experimented with AI or automation at work and are keen to explore what agents and new workflows can do. You can tell us what you tried, the problem you were solving and what you learned.</li> <li>You’re happy to stay hands-on with customers. You enjoy sales conversations yourself and use what you learn to help others improve.</li> <li>You use data to understand performance. You can look at a funnel or pipeline, ask good questions and turn the answers into practical action.</li> <li>You work well with people in different teams. You can explain what your team and customers need, share evidence and help colleagues find solutions together.</li> <li>You care about doing the right thing for customers. You’re comfortable working within clear standards and learning what it takes to sell in a regulated environment.</li> <li>You might have built your experience in financial services, technology or another business selling to businesses. We care more about what you’ve done and how you think than the exact path you took to get here.</li> <li>You don’t need to tick every box. If this role excites you and you think you could make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t have everything that’s listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <h3><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></h3> <p>💰 £60k – £80k base salary, plus on-target commission based on team performance. Total on-target earnings are approximately £100k – £135k</p> <p>📍 This role is based in our London office. You’ll work from the office at least 3 days a week to stay close to your team.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We’ll set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! Read our <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">full list of benefits</a>.</p> <h4><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></h4> <ul> <li>30-minute introductory call with a recruiter</li> <li>A full interview loop covering role-specific skills, behaviours and values</li> <li>A conversation with a member of the team</li> <li>Final interview with the hiring manager at our London office</li> </ul> <p>We’ll share more details about the interview process and timing as you progress. Your schedule is important to us, so we’ll be as flexible as possible.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">read them here</a>.</p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-OH #LI-LONDON</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.</p></div>

title: Senior Account Manager - Influencers & Campaigns (f/m/d)
description: <p><strong>Purpose of Position</strong></p> <p>This is a unique role bespoke to the Nike EMEA Affiliate Program. The Senior Account Manager, Influencers & Campaigns is responsible for the day-to-day management, planning, and execution of Nike's creator and content affiliate marketing activity across the UK & supporting EMEA markets.<br>Acting as the key operational lead, this role oversees the end-to-end delivery of both Nike brand campaigns and evergreen/ always-on creator workstreams, ensuring all activations are executed seamlessly and aligned to Nike's strategic, commercial, and brand objectives.<br>The role manages creator partnerships across the affiliate programme, leads creator network relationships, and coordinates cross-functional stakeholders to bring campaigns to life from briefing and talent selection through to activation, reporting, and optimisation.<br>This role works closely with the Global Client Strategy Lead and Nike, along with internal teams, and external partners. The Senior Account Manager ensures creator activity drives measurable business results while maintaining a premium brand experience and strong operational excellence.<strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Key Tasks</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage the end-to-end delivery of Nike creator campaigns across multiple EMEA markets, from creator sourcing and briefing through to activation, optimisation and reporting.</li> <li>Oversee the day-to-day running of affiliate creator programmes, including creator sourcing, recruitment, approvals and ongoing programme engagement.</li> <li>Coordinate campaign execution across Nike stakeholders, internal teams and external partners, ensuring clear communication of briefs, deliverables and timelines, while providing regular campaign status updates to the client.</li> <li>Oversee creator agreements, usage and exclusivity rights across campaigns, ensuring terms are clearly documented and agreed with creators and partners.</li> <li>Manage and maintain strong relationships with creators, agencies, influencer networks and Nike stakeholders across multiple markets, supporting effective collaboration and campaign delivery.</li> <li>Oversee campaign budgets across multiple markets, managing commission rates and fixed fees to ensure timely and accurate compensation.</li> <li>Understand the end-to-end affiliate creator journey and linking capabilities across social platforms, including how different content placements and link formats drive traffic back to Nike.com and enable performance tracking.</li> <li>Generate and manage unique campaign tracking links and click refs, ensuring activity can be accurately tracked, attributed and reported against campaign KPIs.</li> <li>Monitor campaign performance and develop post-campaign analysis reports, presenting actionable insights and recommendations to key channel stakeholders to inform future activations.</li> <li>Own and maintain creator onboarding documents, content title: Business Operations Manager
description: About Motorway Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better. The Role The Business Operations Manager works directly with the VP of Seller Operations to define, prioritise, and deliver strategic initiatives that improve how Motorway operates, grows, and delivers value to our sellers. This is a high-impact, dynamic leadership role focused on solving critical operational and commercial problems across the entire seller journey. You will be responsible for defining and managing the implementation of initiatives that improve the end-to-end seller experience, launching new solutions, and optimising existing processes. You will combine deep analytical thinking with robust program management to drive conversion, improve customer experience, reduce operational costs, and increase automation across the business. The scope of this role is intentionally broad and highly cross-functional. You will partner closely with senior stakeholders across operations, product, engineering, finance, marketing, and commercial teams to develop joint plans, align priorities, and execute complex solutions. Motorway moves quickly and operates in a constantly evolving environment. This role suits a strategic operator who thrives in ambiguity, possesses natural commercial curiosity, and excels at taking ownership of messy, complex problems and turning them into structured, scalable solutions. We’re looking for someone who instinctively looks for smarter ways to get things done, whether that is redesigning a process, automating manual work or using AI / Tooling to solve problems. Location: Based in London, with a requirement to travel to our Brighton office once a week. Key Responsibilities Support the definition of long-term improvement plans across Motorway operations, clearly articulating how these initiatives will enhance the overall seller experience. Deep dive into operational, financial, and product data to diagnose problems, build financial models, and uncover both short-term quick wins and long-term strategic opportunities across the seller journey (from enquiry through to post-sale). Lead major new and existing initiatives from concept through to delivery, taking full responsibility for the realisation of business case goals and course-correcting as required. Coordinate and drive delivery across partner teams (including product/tech, marketing, finance, and commercial teams), setting clear KPIs and phased goals to ensure all stakeholders meet their deliverables. Define, prioritise, and track initiatives that drive measurable impact across revenue, CX, and cost, establishing robust tracking frameworks and success metrics. Drive automation and process improvements to reduce manual work. Actively explore and apply emerging technologies, including AI tools, to improve workflows, decision-making, and operational scalability. Simplify highly complex operational problems and translate them into clear, actionable roadmaps and business cases for senior leadership and cross-functional partners. What You’ll Have Experience in business operations, management consulting, or a strategic growth role, with a demonstrable history of taking initiatives from idea to execution. Strong capability in analysing data, building financial models to prioritise opportunities, and translating metrics into strategic decisions. Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate, align, and drive accountability across diverse teams like product, marketing, and finance. High levels of ownership, pace, and adaptability. You thrive in fast-changing environments and can structure vague problems into clear execution plans. You actively explore and use AI tools to supercharge how you think, analyse data, and execute work, and you are excited about applying these tools to solve real business problems. A mindset focused on ROI, KPIs, and business case realisation, always balancing operational efficiency with an exceptional seller experience. title: Senior Product Engineer
description: Senior Product Engineer Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain? The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual, and broken. Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice . We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it. Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers, and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, that can grade, price, and categorise items with just a photo, turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable, and tradable global inventory layer. Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator, and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates. Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe, and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally. We're looking for people who want to build something that matters, and move fast doing it. Sound good? Keep reading. About the Role This is a Senior Product Engineer role in Fleek's product engineering team, working across the stack. You'll report into our CTO, Sanket Agarwal (ex-Google, Postmates), and work embedded with a product manager and designer in a small, senior squad focused on the core marketplace experience. Why This Role Stands Out Fleek is digitising an industry that has never had technology. There are no existing playbooks for building an ecommerce experience around secondhand fashion at wholesale scale, where every item is unique, inventory is unpredictable, quality is graded by AI, and the supply chain spans three continents. You will be designing how the transaction layer works for a market that hasn't existed before. You will be on our Growth team, owning the ecommerce journey from discovery to checkout, payment and credit systems, order management, and seller tools. Your systems will handle 500,000+ items a month today and million+ by the end of the year. AI is at the core of everything we do, so you'll work closely with our data and AI teams to build the product features and services that connect FleekSort's classification engine to the marketplace experience. We're looking for a product engineer who can think about how systems affect buyers and sellers at scale. You'll be expected to understand the business problems your code solves, and challenge whether we're solving the right ones. What Makes You a Fleek Product Engineer? Product-Obsessed Builder: You think about what the seller sees when their inventory goes live, or why a buyer drops off at checkout. You instinctively connect technical decisions to commercial outcomes. Comfortable with Ambiguity: We're building systems for workflows that didn't exist before Fleek. You thrive when the problem is undefined and collaboration is key. Customer-Focused Thinker: You understand the dynamics of customer platforms and can understand how technical choices affect customers and our broader marketplace. Owner, Not Renter: You take a feature from problem definition to production and monitor it afterwards. Startup Pace: You've worked in environments where shipping matters more than perfection, where you deploy daily, and where velocity is a competitive advantage. What You'll Do Own the Ecommerce Journey: Design and build the features and systems powering Fleek's core marketplace, across frontend and backend, from item discovery and search through to checkout, payment, and post-purchase. These are product features that directly drive GMV. Integrate AI into the Product: Build the features and services that connect FleekSort's AI classification engine to the marketplace experience, ensuring grading, pricing, and categorisation flow seamlessly into listings, search, and buyer workflows. Design for Scale: Architect systems that handle 500K+ items per month today, with a clear path to millions. Make pragmatic trade-offs between speed of delivery and long-term scalability. Shape Technical Direction: Contribute to architectural decisions across the stack. Challenge assumptions, propose alternatives, and help define engineering standards for a fast-growing team. Mentor and Elevate: Support the growth of more junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing. Help raise the technical bar across the team. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work embedded with your product manager and designer to define what gets built. Partner with data, AI, and operations teams to turn complex real-world logistics into reliable, scalable software. What You Bring A track record of shipping product: You've built and owned user-facing features end to end, at a marketplace, fintech or consumer company; we care more about what you've shipped than how many years it took. You start from the user: You talk to buyers and sellers, watch where they get stuck, and can explain why what you're building matters to the person using it. You think like a PM: You shape the problem as well as the solution, push back when something doesn't feel right, and tie your work to GMV, conversion or retention. You ship fast and learn: You'd rather put a working version in front of users this week than a perfect one next quarter, and you're used to deploying daily. You measure what you build: You define success before you start and use data, user feedback and experiments to decide what to build next. You build AI-native: You use AI tools every day to move faster, and you've shipped features on LLMs or ML models, with evals to know they work. You work across the stack: You're strong in TypeScript and Node.js and comfortable enough on the frontend and in the data layer to ship a feature end to end, whichever way you lean. You have sound judgement: You make sensible trade-offs between speed and scale, think about failure modes in systems that move real money, and know when good enough is good enough. Nice to Have Experience with marketplace dynamics: two-sided platforms, pricing, trust, supply-demand matching Familiarity with international systems and distributed teams across multiple time zones A genuine excitement for building something from scratch in a category that didn't exist three years ago. This Role Isn't for You If You Want: Narrow, siloed ownership where you only touch one service and never see the user Detailed specs handed to you before you start, we define problems together A slow-moving, highly structured environment with long release cycles Fully remote work, this team is on-site in London 3-4 days per week Pure infrastructure or platform work with no product exposure Ready to build the infrastructure for the world's fastest-growing fashion economy? If you want to work on genuinely hard problems, with a world-class team, at a company that's tripling annually, we'd love to hear from you. The Practicalities Location: London HQ, Commercial St, E1 (Liverpool St / Aldgate East) Work model: On-site Stage: Post-Series B, hyper-growth Team: 100+ across London, India, and Pakistan Stack: TypeScript and Node.js across frontend and backend, AI/ML integration Culture: High ownership, non-hierarchical, fast-moving. Founder-led with strong opinions loosely held. What's In It for You? Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for a $350 billion market that has never been digitised. Joining now means you'll be part of the team that defines how the secondhand economy works, at scale, globally. Why people join Fleek The problem is real: 9 million items saved from landfill since 2022. Your work has tangible, measurable impact. The AI is genuinely novel: FleekSort is an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, turning an opaque manual trade into a structured global inventory layer. This isn't a GPT wrapper. The growth is exceptional: Tripling year-on-year, ~$50M raised, Series B closed. Backed by a16z, Y Combinator, HV Capital, with advisors from Depop, Shopify, and Postmates. The timing is perfect: The secondhand market is projected to reach $350B by 2027. EU regulation is mandating the infrastructure Fleek builds. You're catching a wave. You'll have real ownership: 100-person company, no bureaucracy. You'll shape decisions and see the impact of your work immediately. Our Values Five values shape how we work at Fleek: Dream Big and Disrupt Yourself: Push the most ambitious version of what you're building. Step out of your comfort zone. Nothing is out of reach. Absolute Ownership: The buck stops with you. Drive initiatives to completion. Experiment, learn, persevere. The job isn't done until the job is done. Curiosity Leads the Way: Don't accept anything at face value. Ask questions you don't know the answer to. That's how you innovate. Talk to the Customer: Deeply understand their challenges, motivations, and ambitions. Every decision starts with the customer at the centre. Embrace Diversity: A global team building for a global supply chain. Bring your authentic self and embrace the diversity of everyone you encounter. title: Lead Biosensor Scientist - Continuous Monitoring
description: About Level Zero Level Zero is pioneering next-generation biosensor technology for precise, real-time monitoring of critical endocrine biomarkers. Recognised as one of the top 20 startups across all categories worldwide at TechCrunch Disrupt 2024 - and backed by top-tier organisations like SOSV and Entrepreneur First - we’re pushing the boundaries of biochemistry and nanotechnology to revolutionize personalised health. Founded by two seasoned engineers, we bring extensive experience in R&D, technical innovation, and commercial strategy to transform the way people monitor their health. Our mission is bold: to revolutionise health management by delivering clinical-grade data directly to individuals, wherever they are. We’re seeking driven innovators to join us in pushing the boundaries of biosensing and health tech, making personalised health monitoring a reality for everyone. To achieve this ambitious vision, we’re assembling the best team in the world - dedicated to turning cutting-edge science into life-changing, real-world solutions. About the Role We are seeking a lead biosensor scientist to drive the development and commercialisation of our continuous aptamer sensor platform. The ideal candidate will have proven expertise in developing continuous monitoring devices for regulated healthcare applications, demonstrated experience transitioning research-stage sensors into manufacturing-ready products, and a track record working with in vivo validation studies and large-scale analytical verification programs. This is a full-time, in-person role primarily based in London.
